University of Primorska (Slovenia, EU) is inviting applications for two postdoctoral researcher positions in Computer Science. This is an open call: the research topic and mentoring arrangements will be defined based on the candidate’s expertise and their fit with UP FAMNIT’s strengths, including Human–Computer Interaction, Distributed Ledger Technologies (blockchain), Language Technologies, Mixed Reality, Recommender Systems, Distributed Systems, and Graph Theory.

We welcome candidates with a strong research record who are eager to develop an independent research agenda and contribute to preparing competitive project proposals.
